audit: VISERON P2.3 — Server Migration Backup Audit

source.machine: Intel i5-1235U, 8GB RAM, Windows 11 Home, Intel UHD iGPU

target.machine: UpCloud — AMD EPYC 7542, 32 cores, 256GB RAM, Windows Server 2025 Standard
target.implications: 32x threads vs 12, 32x RAM vs 8GB. Can run Ollama 70B, Wan2.1 14B+GPU, multi-model serving.

mustBackup: src/ — all source code (241 TypeScript files)
data/ — audit history, reports, experience records, knowledge (300MB)
skills/vendor/ — 10 skill collections (excluded from git, MUST be migrated)
canRebuild: dist/ — npm run build on target

runtime.node: v24+ required (package.json uses modern ES features)

migrationChecklist: 1. Run security audit: scan for secrets in committed files
2. Create backup: zip entire repo (excl node_modules, .git)
3. Export .env — move to secure location, NEVER in backup zip
4. Git clone --mirror or just copy .git separately
5. Transfer backup to target server (SCP, SFTP, or cloud storage)
6. On target: install Node v24+, Python 3.10+, Git, Ollama
7. On target: npm install && npm run build
8. On target: restore .env from secure location
9. On target: npm run models:pull (Ollama qwen2.5:3b + 1.5b)
10. On target: npm start — verify all endpoints respond
11. On target: npm test — verify all 67 tests pass
12. Run npm run wan21 benchmark — verify GPU detection
13. Run npm run p09 — verify Engineering Squad works
14. Update DNS / firewall / nginx to point to new server
15. Decommission old laptop (or keep as dev/test)

ready: Code and data structure fully portable
